facts.text: The brochure is one page.
The brochure is for Module 1.2.112 on Daggerheart.
You are an Ultimate.
An Ultimate is the one thing your character does best.
keywords: the one thing your character does best

facts.text: Your Ultimate is written under their name on the sheet.
keywords: written under their name on the sheet

facts.text: Your six statistics are Leg, Body, Hand, Eye, Shadow, and Head.
keywords: Leg, Body, Hand, Eye, Shadow, and Head

facts.text: You start with Health 4.
You start with Sanity 6.
You start with Hope 2.
Hope is at most 6.
You start with 2 Experiences.
Experiences are short lines from your past on your sheet.
keywords: short lines from your past on your sheet

facts.text: An Experience is worth +2 when it applies to a roll.
keywords: worth +2 each when one applies to a roll

facts.text: At zero Sanity you are in Breakdown.

keywords: 1 action fewer, outside the Class Trial

facts.text: A roll with Hope gives you 1 Hope.
keywords: A roll with Hope gives you 1 Hope

keywords: Morning, Noon, Afternoon, Evening, and Night

facts.text: Each time of day opens with an Eclipse.
Your 2 actions are refilled when a time of day begins.
Your 1 Free Move is refilled when a time of day begins.
Moving inside your room is free.
keywords: Moving inside your room is free

facts.text: Drag your token to move.
Your first crossing into a connected room is your Free Move.
keywords: your first crossing into a connected room is your Free Move

facts.text: Every further crossing costs 1 action.

keywords: the cost lands when you arrive

facts.text: Locked doors, sealed rooms, other students' bedrooms (without a key), and Chained turn you back.

keywords: keeps you in your room until the time of day ends

facts.text: In the Eclipse the lights are out.
keywords: In the Eclipse the lights are out

facts.text: In the Eclipse nobody sees anybody.
In the Eclipse nobody hears anybody.
You place your token up to 2 connected rooms away.
In the Night Eclipse you place your token in any room.
keywords: in any room in the Night Eclipse

facts.text: You see only your room.
You see only the people in your room.
Visited rooms are veiled.
The rest of the rooms are fog.
If your table uses Separate voice in each room, your voice follows your token.
If your table uses Separate voice in each room, you hear only your room.
Every room has Search Tokens.
A room usually has 3 Search Tokens.
Search Tokens are shared by everybody.
During the Eclipse nothing spends an action but a killing you declare.
keywords: nothing spends an action but a killing you declare

facts.text: A killing you declare is a Direct Murder or turning on the killer.
keywords: a Direct Murder, or turning on the killer

facts.text: During the Eclipse there are no Calls.
Each action costs 1 action.
An action costs 1 action except where its row says otherwise.
keywords: except where its row says otherwise

facts.text: A Remnant is what an act leaves on the map.
keywords: what an act leaves on the map

facts.text: A Truth Bullet is your copy of a Remnant.
A Truth Bullet is the evidence you carry.
Things come in Tiers from 0 to 3.
Tier 0 is a random, seemingly useless object.
Tier 3 is made strictly for the job.
Search is rolled with Eye.
Search can be rolled with another statistic the GM approves.
Name what you want when you Search.
Search needs 8+ for Tier 0, 12+ for Tier 1, 18+ for Tier 2.
A critical on Search gives 1 tier more.
Search spends a Search Token.
Taking a Murder Weapon or a Cleaning Tool leaves a Remnant.
keywords: Taking a Murder Weapon or a Cleaning Tool leaves a Remnant

facts.text: Observe is rolled with Eye.
Observe copies a Remnant into your inventory as a Neutral Truth Bullet.
keywords: Copies a Remnant into your inventory as a Neutral Truth Bullet

facts.text: A Neutral Truth Bullet is one whose kind you do not know until it is analyzed.
keywords: one whose kind you do not know until it is analyzed

facts.text: A miss on Observe costs 1 Sanity.
Analyze is rolled with Head.
Analyze can identify a Truth Bullet.
A miss on identifying a Truth Bullet locks it until the chapter ends.
keywords: a miss locks it until the chapter ends

facts.text: Analyze can ask the GM for a hint at 14+ / 18+.
keywords: ask the GM for a hint (14+ / 18+)

facts.text: Analyze can Find Stash at 16+.
Analyze can Find Passage at 16+.
Infiltrate is rolled with Shadow, Leg, Body, or Hand.
Infiltrate covers Listen, Echoes, Tail Someone, Dash, Shut the Door, Force the Door, Pick the Lock, and Keep Watch.
Listen at 14+ tells how many are next door.
Listen at 18+ tells who is next door.
A critical on Listen covers every neighboring room.
Rooms you have not been in stay unnamed: Unexplored room 1, 2...
keywords: rooms you have not been in stay unnamed

facts.text: Dash at 12+ gives 2 free crossings, at 18+ 3, on a critical 4.

Taking something from somebody's pockets needs 12+, or 15+ unseen.
keywords: Take (12+, unseen 15+) something from somebody's pockets

facts.text: Planting one of your things in somebody's pockets needs 8+, or 13+ unseen.
keywords: plant (8+, unseen 13+) one of your things there

facts.text: Seeing what they carry takes nothing.
keywords: see what they carry, which takes nothing

facts.text: To see what they carry, ask first.
After a refusal, seeing what they carry needs Body 12+.
Unseen, seeing what they carry needs Shadow 15+ then Hand 10+.
Projects are rolled with the project's own roll.
On a project, 12+ gives +1 progress and 18+ gives +2.
On a project, a critical gives +2 progress.
On a project, a critical gives your action back.
Propose new projects to the GM.
keywords: Propose new ones to the GM

facts.text: Sabotage is among the Projects.
Sabotage always leaves a Remnant.
Facilities need no roll, or the row's roll.
Short Rest costs 1 action, picks 1, and is allowed once per time of day.
keywords: Short Rest: 1 action, pick 1, once per time of day

facts.text: Long Rest costs 2 actions, picks 2, and is allowed once per session.
keywords: Long Rest: 2 actions, pick 2, once per session

facts.text: Sleep restores Health, Meal Sanity, Breath Hope.
keywords: Sleep restores Health, Meal Sanity, Breath Hope

facts.text: The rests work only in rooms marked for them.
keywords: the rests work only in rooms marked for them

facts.text: Below the rests is what your room offers.
keywords: Below them is what your room offers

facts.text: For a Dynamic Action you propose and the GM sets.
A Dynamic Action lets you describe anything.
The GM sets the difficulty of a Dynamic Action.
Gentler thresholds are the reward for inventing something.
keywords: Gentler thresholds are the reward for inventing something

facts.text: Tamper is rolled with Shadow.

keywords: Erase a Trace you have found in this room (Hidden 9 to Obvious 18)

facts.text: Tamper can Reshape a Trace, 3 lower.
Reshaping a Trace needs the GM to approve the new words.
keywords: the GM approves the new words

facts.text: Neither erasing nor reshaping works on a Reinforced Trace.
Tamper can plant a Misleading Trail at 15.
The Tamper attempt itself costs 1 action.
The Tamper attempt itself costs no Sanity.
With no action left, no Tamper.
keywords: with no action left, no Tamper

facts.text: Witnesses mean a cover roll first.
keywords: Witnesses mean a cover roll first

facts.text: The cover roll is 16.
Being caught at Tamper costs Sanity.
keywords: being caught at it costs Sanity

facts.text: Being caught costs 1 Sanity on a success with Despair or a failure, 2 on a failure with Despair.
keywords: 1 on a success with Despair or a failure, 2 on a failure with Despair

facts.text: Direct Murder is ruled by the GM.

keywords: It is judged when the lights come up

facts.text: Leave a Clue beats 12.
